verdict.rationale: The GitHub README mentions an interactive playground for testing requests and generating request code, which is part of the Dockerized FastAPI server, and the docs include copy-paste code examples such as `crawler.arun`. However, there is no evidence of a browsable, interactive API reference: probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any docs path, and the playground is only a one-line mention. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference covering endpoints and parameters, a published OpenAPI spec, runnable examples embedded in the reference docs, and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of the playground.
